pages.title: Mundane Hexbrew
pages.text: Water + ghost fire cap + dream cap, brewed 10 seconds, yields 1000 mB. Neither drinkable nor throwable on its own: it is the base fluid every other brew builds on. Bottles carry 250 mB each.

pages.title: Explosive Hexbrew
pages.text: Mundane hexbrew + blaze powder + gunpowder, brewed 10 seconds. Throw the bottle for a power-4 blast that keeps blocks intact and spares you and your allies.

pages.title: Miasma Hexbrew
pages.text: Water + demonic miasma cap + spider eye + 4 rotten flesh, brewed 20 seconds. A throwable bottle that inflicts the Miasma effect for 60 seconds where it shatters.
